title: Listing Tenure Allowance on the Cleaning Fee — Roamhaven Listings Decision Card
content:
# Listing Tenure Allowance on the Cleaning Fee

*Decision card for Roamhaven Listings.*

On top of the standard cleaning-fee ceiling, a listing may carry a listing tenure allowance, worked out on the day of the cleaning-fee reset from the listing's first listed date — the date it was first published.

| Whole months from the listing's first listed date to the day of the reset | Listing tenure allowance |
|---|---|
| 36 or more | $15.00 |
| at least 12 and fewer than 36 | $8.00 |
| fewer than 12 | none |

The allowance is added to the listing's cleaning-fee ceiling.

## Edge readings (hypothetical listings, reset on 2026-06-15)

| First listed date | Whole months back | Allowance |
|---|---|---|
| 2023-06-15 | 36 | $15.00 |
| 2023-06-16 | 35 | $8.00 |
| 2025-06-15 | 12 | $8.00 |
| 2025-06-16 | 11 | none |
